mainEntity.name: How does the AI customer service agent work for my Amazon store?

acceptedAnswer.text: The AI agent is deployed on your own server using open-source Dify RAG framework and DeepSeek LLM. It learns from your product documentation, past customer conversations, and returns policy to automatically handle 80% of repetitive buyer questions — 24/7, in 12 languages.

mainEntity.name: What is the cost compared to hiring customer service agents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our Starter plan is $99/month plus a one-time $299 setup fee. A single outsourced customer service agent costs $800-1,500/month. Our solution handles the same volume at a fraction of the cost, works 24/7 across time zones.

mainEntity.name: Where is my customer data stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: All data is stored on YOUR server. Nothing goes to our cloud. The code is open-source (Dify on GitHub with 60k+ stars), so you can audit it yourself. If you ever stop working with us, your system keeps running.

mainEntity.name: Which languages does the AI agent support?

acceptedAnswer.text: The agent supports 12 languages natively: English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Korean, Arabic, and Russian. It auto-detects the customer's language and responds naturally.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to set up?

acceptedAnswer.text: From signing up to having your AI agent online, it takes 3-5 business days. We handle the full setup: server deployment, knowledge base construction, and accuracy testing.
We offer three fixed-price tiers. Starter: $299 setup + $99/month. Growth: $499 setup + $199/month. Pro: $999 setup + $399/month. No per-seat fees, no per-message charges, no hidden usage costs.
